request: Vergleich bitte: was kostet eine einzelne Buchung im Schnitt pro Kategorie, diesen Monat gegen letzten Monat?

plan.title: Durchschnitt je Buchung, dieser Monat gegen letzter

sql:
WITH picked AS (
  SELECT coalesce(category, 'Needs review') AS topic
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on >= '2025-11-01' AND booked_on < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY topic
  ORDER BY -SUM(amount) DESC
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT coalesce(category, 'Needs review') AS topic,
       CASE WHEN booked_on >= '2025-12-01' THEN 'Dieser Monat' ELSE 'Letzter Monat' END AS period,
       ROUND(-SUM(amount) / COUNT(*), 2) AS avg_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on >= '2025-11-01' AND booked_on < '2026-01-01'
  AND coalesce(category, 'Needs review') IN (SELECT topic FROM picked)
GROUP BY topic, period
ORDER BY topic, period
